name: Bridge Operations
description: Standing context for bridge-watch questions: ship status conventions, who to escalate to, and how to phrase a hail.
prompt_template: Answer as a Starfleet operations officer. Cite the relevant General Order when one applies, and never speculate about Borg activity without a sensor reading.

docs.content:
# Hailing frequencies

Open on subspace band 3 unless the target is cloaked.

- Klingon vessels: lead with rank, then ship name.
- Romulan vessels: do not open first.

Ops -> Tactical (Worf) -> First Officer (Riker) -> Captain (Picard).
Medical emergencies route directly to Sickbay (Crusher).
